item.description: In oral cultures, language is considered a vital means of transmitting social norms, values, and local wisdom to the next generation. item.description: In Indonesia, to strengthen the memorization and comprehension of holy Qur’anic verses among youth, short verses are often adapted into senandung (chanting).
